messages:
sam: Heads-up: console alerted on a spike in compat.fallback_rate at 02:05 UTC. Many v1 clients suddenly routed to v2-shim. :grimacing:
ana: looking at routing logs now. sample payloads show x-client-version: v1 but missing legacy header `x-tenant-meta`. route logic treated as incompatible.
michael: that matches the config change we rolled yesterday — fallback_threshold=0.95. Might be too strict for noisy headers.
tara: proposed short-term fix: enable smoothing (moving avg window 30s) for compatibility score and temporarily lower threshold to 0.90 for affected tenants.
sam: agree. also add tenant tag "compat_grace" so console won't auto-enforce policy flips for those tenants.
nana: UX ask: rollouts page should expose smoothing toggle + preview of "effective fallback_rate" before commit. ops will love a preview.
michael: backend shim: accept `fallback_smoothing=ema(0.2)` in routing config and return simulated fallback_rate via POST /api/rollout/preview.
tara: applying temp change to @high-volume-prod and @billing-prod now.
ops-bot: alert acknowledged. will monitor compat.fallback_rate and latency.p95 for 20m.
sam: follow-ups: ana -> add backend support + unit test; michael -> add preview endpoint; nana -> UX toggle copy; tara -> list tenants changed and timeline. we'll reconvene in 30m. :thumbsup:
